# 1. Preparations
# 1.1 Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
packageVersion('tidyverse')
library(patchwork)
packageVersion('patchwork')
library(ggrepel)
packageVersion('ggrepel')
library(propagate)
packageVersion('propagate')
library(pROC)
packageVersion('pROC')
library(scales)
packageVersion('scales')
```
# 1.2 Read the data

I worked with a training data set (data) to explore trends and fit models and a test dataset (test_genera) to test the models' performance

#### Training data
```{r}
data=read.csv('damage_data_core_genera.csv')
```
```{r}
data_w = pivot_wider(data[,-c(3:4)],
           names_from = tool_param,
           values_from = value )
data_w$mapdamage_1_over_lambda=1/data_w$mapdamage_lambda
data_w$pydamage_1over_p=1/data_w$pydamage_p
data_w$qPCRcopies_per_uL_and_mg_rock=data_w$qPCRcopies_per_uL/data_w$mass_mg
```
#### Test data
```{r}
test_genera = read_csv("damage_data_test_genera.csv")
```
```{r}
test_genera_w = pivot_wider(test_genera[,-c(3:4)],
           names_from = tool_param,
           values_from = value )
test_genera_w$qPCRcopies_per_uL_and_mg_rock=test_genera_w$qPCRcopies_per_uL/test_genera_w$mass_mg
```

## 2.2 GC content
```{r}

gc_over_time <- data_w %>%
group_by(genus) %>%
  mutate(weight_len = log1p(pydamage_len),  # log(1 + len) to handle zeros safely
         weight_len = weight_len / max(weight_len, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
do({
fit <- lm(gc_gc ~ median_age_yrs_bf_1950, data = .,weights = weight_len)
s <- summary(fit)
# slope = coefficient for age
slope <- coef(s)["median_age_yrs_bf_1950", "Estimate"]
se    <- coef(s)["median_age_yrs_bf_1950", "Std. Error"]
tval  <- coef(s)["median_age_yrs_bf_1950", "t value"]
pval  <- coef(s)["median_age_yrs_bf_1950", "Pr(>|t|)"]
r2    <- s$r.squared
adjr2 <- s$adj.r.squared
data.frame(
slope = slope,
se = se,
tval = tval,
pval = pval,
r2 = r2,
adjr2 = adjr2
)
}) %>%
ungroup() %>%
mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"))
print(gc_over_time)
```

There is no significant temporal trend in GC content, except for Conexibacter, where the GC content is weakly falling with increasing age.

For genera with low to mid GC-content according to literature, the observed GC content in the aDNA pseudo-bins was higher than the literature value  

# 3. Correlation analysis
## 3.1 Correlation of parameters with age
I correlated all damage parameters with age but separated by genus to see if the trends are consistent.
I chose Spearman correlation because the expected relationship is non-linear.

```{r}
cor_data = data[data$tool_param %in% c("pydamage_pmin","pydamage_pmax","pydamage_p" ,"mapdamage_delta_d",     "mapdamage_delta_s","mapdamage_lambda","compute_length_mode", "compute_length_geom_p"),] %>%
  group_by(genus, tool_param) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_test = list(cor.test(median_age_yrs_bf_1950,  if(tool_param[1] %in% c("")) 1 / value else value, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ .x$p.value)
  )
```
I'm adjusting p-values for multiple testing with the Banjamini-Hochberg method and create labels for plotting
```{r}
cor_data = cor_data %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  mutate(
    label = sprintf("rho = %.2f\nadj.p = %.3g", estimate, p_adj),
    stars = case_when(
    p_adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
    p_adj <= 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE          ~ ""),
    label_short = paste0(round(estimate, 2), stars))
```
####  Heatmap
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
cor= cor_data %>% mutate(class=sub("_.*", "", tool_param)) %>%  ggplot(aes(y=factor(genus, levels=c('nitrospira','candidatus_nitrosotenuis','conexibacter','candidatus_methylomirabilis', 'piscinibacter','nitrosotalea')), x=factor(tool_param,levels=c('compute_length_geom_p','compute_length_mode','mapdamage_delta_s','mapdamage_delta_d','mapdamage_lambda','pydamage_pmax','pydamage_pmin','pydamage_p')), fill=estimate))+
```

Beyond 32000 years temporal trends reversed or became unstable in multiple parameters and genera. This conincides with a change in the microfabric of TM-17. Therefore we restrict the damage modelling to samples younger than 32000y.

# 4. Exponential saturation models: Damage over time
## 4.1 delta_s over time
### 4.1.1 Fit
```{r}
plottable_delta_s=data_w[data_w$median_age_yrs_bf_1950<32000,c('median_age_yrs_bf_1950', 'mapdamage_delta_s', 'genus','sample','gc_gc')]
fit_delta_s <- nls(mapdamage_delta_s  ~ 1 - exp(-r * median_age_yrs_bf_1950),data = plottable_delta_s,start = list(r = 1e-3))
summary(fit_delta_s)
```
### 4.1.2 Confidence and Prediction interval
```{r,message=FALSE}
# Prediction interval (new observation)
PI_delta_s <- predictNLS(fit_delta_s,
                     newdata =data.frame(median_age_yrs_bf_1950=plottable_delta_s$median_age_yrs_bf_1950),interval = "prediction",alpha = 0.05,nsim = 10000)$summary
CI_delta_s <- predictNLS(fit_delta_s,newdata =data.frame(median_age_yrs_bf_1950=plottable_delta_s$median_age_yrs_bf_1950),interval = "confidence",alpha = 0.05,nsim = 10000)$summary
```

### 4.1.3 Plot
```{r}
plottable_delta_s$PI_lower <- PI_delta_s[, "Sim.2.5%"]
plottable_delta_s$PI_upper <- PI_delta_s[, "Sim.97.5%"]
plottable_delta_s$CI_lower <- CI_delta_s[, "Sim.2.5%"]
plottable_delta_s$CI_upper <- CI_delta_s[, "Sim.97.5%"]
plottable_delta_s$fitted <- predict(fit_delta_s)
plottable_delta_s$residual=residuals(fit_delta_s)

p_deltas=ggplot(plottable_delta_s, aes(x = median_age_yrs_bf_1950)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = PI_lower,color='95% PI'),linetype='twodash')+
  geom_line(aes(y= pmin(pmax(PI_upper, 0), 1),color='95% PI'),linetype='twodash')+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = median_age_yrs_bf_1950,
                  ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper, fill = "95% CI"), alpha=0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = median_age_yrs_bf_1950, y = mapdamage_delta_s),color = "gray40", shape = 4) +
  geom_line(aes(x = median_age_yrs_bf_1950, y = fitted), color = "black") +
  labs( x = "Nominal Age (Years BP)", y = expression(delta[s]),caption= expression("Fit: "~
  delta[s] == 1 - e^{-r %*% Age}) )+
  geom_hline(yintercept=1, colour='darkred')+
  scale_color_manual(name = "",
    values = c( '95% PI' = "gray40"))+
  scale_fill_manual('', values = c("95% CI" = "lightblue3"))+
  theme_bw(base_size=9)
  
p_deltas
```
### 4.1.4 Characteristic values

```{r}
# time to saturation (99%)
(-1/coef(fit_delta_s)['r'])*log(0.01)
```

### 4.1.5 Residuals
```{r}

geom_point(shape=4)+
geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
theme_bw(base_size = 9)+
labs(x='Nominal Age (Years BP)', y='Residual', title='Residuals', subtitle=expression(~delta[s]*' vs. Age Model'))+
scale_color_manual("Genus", values =c( "darkred",   "lightblue3",    '#009E73',    "darkorchid",   "blue4",'#E66101'),
                    labels = c("Cand. Methylomirabilis", "Cand. Nitrosotenuis", "Conexibacter", "Nitrosotalea", "Nitrospira", "Piscinibacter"))
delta_s_res
```

## 4.2 pmax over time
### 4.2.1 Fit
```{r}
plottable_pmax=data_w[data_w$median_age_yrs_bf_1950<32000,c('median_age_yrs_bf_1950', 'pydamage_pmax','genus', 'sample', 'gc_gc')]
# Fit the model using nls
fit_pmax <- nls(pydamage_pmax  ~ a+b * (1 - exp(-r * median_age_yrs_bf_1950)),
data = plottable_pmax,
start = list(r = 1e-4, b=0.6,a=0.2))
summary(fit_pmax)

```
### 4.2.2 Confidence and Prediction intervals
```{r,message=FALSE}
# Confidence interval (mean curve)
CI_pmax = predictNLS(fit_pmax, newdata = data.frame(median_age_yrs_bf_1950=plottable_pmax$median_age_yrs_bf_1950 ), interval = "confidence", alpha = 0.05, nsim = 10000)$summary

# Prediction interval (new observation)
PI_pmax= predictNLS(fit_pmax, newdata =data.frame(median_age_yrs_bf_1950=plottable_pmax$median_age_yrs_bf_1950), interval = "prediction", alpha = 0.05, nsim = 10000)$summary

```

### 4.2.3 Plot

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5 }
plottable_pmax$fitted <- predict(fit_pmax)
plottable_pmax$residual=residuals(fit_pmax)
plottable_pmax$CI_lower <- CI_pmax[, "Sim.2.5%"]
plottable_pmax$CI_upper <- CI_pmax[, "Sim.97.5%"]
plottable_pmax$PI_lower <- PI_pmax[, "Sim.2.5%"]
plottable_pmax$PI_upper <- PI_pmax[, "Sim.97.5%"]

p_pmax= ggplot(plottable_pmax, aes(x = median_age_yrs_bf_1950)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = PI_lower,color='95% PI'),linetype='twodash')+
  geom_line(aes(y= PI_upper,color='95% PI'),linetype='twodash')+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = median_age_yrs_bf_1950,
                  ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper, fill = "95% CI"), alpha=0.5) +
geom_point(aes(x = median_age_yrs_bf_1950, y = pydamage_pmax), shape=4, colour='gray40') +
geom_line(aes(x = median_age_yrs_bf_1950, y = fitted))+
geom_hline(yintercept= coef(fit_pmax)["a"]+coef(fit_pmax)['b'], colour='darkred')+
scale_color_manual(name = "",values = c( '95% PI' = "gray40"))+
scale_fill_manual('', values = c("95% CI" = "lightblue3"))+  
theme_bw(base_size=9)+
scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits=c(0,32000))+
labs(
caption = expression("Fit: "~
p[max] == a + b %*% (1 - e^{-r %*% Age})) ,y=expression(p[max]), x = "Nominal Age (Years BP)")
p_pmax
```

### 4.2.4 characteristic values
```{r}
# 99% saturation time (-1/r)*log(1-0.99)
(-1/coef(fit_pmax)['r'])*log(0.01)
```
```{r}
#saturation value
coef(fit_pmax)['b']+coef(fit_pmax)["a"]
```

### 4.2.5 Residuals
```{r, fig.width=9}

geom_point(shape=4)+
geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
theme_bw(base_size = 9)+
labs(x='Nominal Age (Years BP)', y='Residual',subtitle=expression(~p[max]*' vs. Age Model'))+
scale_color_manual("Genus", values =c( "darkred",   "lightblue3",    '#009E73',    "darkorchid",   "blue4",'#E66101'),
                  labels = c("Cand. Methylomirabilis", "Cand. Nitrosotenuis", "Conexibacter", "Nitrosotalea", "Nitrospira", "Piscinibacter"))
pmax_res
```

## 4.3 p_geom over time
### 4.3.1 Fit
```{r}
plottable_pgeom <- data_w[data_w$median_age_yrs_bf_1950<32000,c('median_age_yrs_bf_1950', 'compute_length_geom_p', 'genus', 'sample','gc_gc')]

fit_pgeom<- nls(compute_length_geom_p ~ a+ b * (1 - exp(-r * median_age_yrs_bf_1950)),
data = plottable_pgeom,
start = list(b = 0.12, r = 0.0001, a=0.02),
control = nls.control(maxiter = 100, warnOnly = FALSE))
# Summary of fit
summary(fit_pgeom)

```
### 4.3.2 Confidence and Predcition intervals
```{r,message=FALSE}
# Confidence interval (mean curve)
CI_pgeom = predictNLS(fit_pgeom, newdata = data.frame(median_age_yrs_bf_1950=plottable_pgeom$median_age_yrs_bf_1950 ), interval = "confidence", alpha = 0.05, nsim = 10000)$summary

# Prediction interval (new observation)
PI_pgeom= predictNLS(fit_pgeom, newdata =data.frame(median_age_yrs_bf_1950=plottable_pgeom$median_age_yrs_bf_1950), interval = "prediction", alpha = 0.05, nsim = 10000)$summary
```

```{r}
# Function to summarize a single model data frame by genus
summarize_by_genus <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(genus) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_gc = median(gc_gc, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_gc=sd(gc_gc, na.rm=TRUE),
      mean_resid = median(residual, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_resid=sd(residual, na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      cell_wall = case_when(
        genus == "conexibacter" ~ "gram_pos",
        genus %in% c("nitrosotalea", "candidatus_nitrosotenuis") ~ "archaeon",
        TRUE ~ "gram_neg"
      ))}
# Apply the summarization to all models
genus_summary_list <- lapply(residuals_overview, summarize_by_genus)
```

```{r}
plot_genus_model = function(genus_summary_list) {
  labels = c(expression(delta[s]), "Mode Fragment Length",expression(1 / lambda),expression(p[geom]), expression(p[max]))
  
  results = vector("list", length(genus_summary_list))
  for (i in seq_along(genus_summary_list)) {
    df = genus_summary_list[[i]]
    results[[i]] = ggplot(
      df,aes(x = mean_gc, y = mean_resid, color = cell_wall, group=1)) +
       geom_smooth( method = "lm",formula = y ~ x,se = FALSE, aes(group = 1), color = "black", linewidth = 0.4)+
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_resid - sd_resid,  ymax = mean_resid + sd_resid),width = 0) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = mean_gc - sd_gc,xmax = mean_gc + sd_gc),height = 0) +
      labs(x = "Mean GC content",y = "Mean residual", title = labels[i]
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9)+
      scale_color_manual('Cell Wall Morphology', values = c('gram_pos'='lightblue3','archaeon'='darkred','gram_neg'='gray40' ),labels=c('gram_pos'='gram+','gram_neg'= 'gram-', 'archaeon'='archaeal'))
  }
  return(results)
}
```

## 5.2 Model inversion and age prediction

```{r}
invert_age = function(pmax, a, b, r) {
  # Return NA if pmax outside model range
  if(pmax <= a | pmax >= (a + b)) return(NA)
  -1 / r * log(1 - (pmax - a)/b)
}
```
```{r}
predict_age_from_pmax <- function(df, pmax_col, model, B = 1000, seed = 1963) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Extract parameter estimates and covariance
  params_est = coef(model)
  cov_mat = vcov(model)
  sigma_resid = summary(model)$sigma
  
  # Prepare storage vectors
  n = nrow(df)
  age_point = numeric(n)
  age_ci_lower <- numeric(n)
  age_ci_upper <- numeric(n)
  age_pi_lower = numeric(n)
  age_pi_upper = numeric(n)
  age_pi_bootstrap = vector("list", n)
  
  for(i in 1:n) {
    pmax = df[[pmax_col]][i]
#Point estimate
    age_point[i] = invert_age(pmax, params_est["a"], params_est["b"], params_est["r"])
    
#CI: parametric bootstrap without residual noise
    param_samples <- mvrnorm(B, mu = params_est, Sigma = cov_mat)
    age_boot_ci <- sapply(1:B, function(j) {
      invert_age(pmax, param_samples[j, "a"], param_samples[j, "b"], param_samples[j, "r"])
    })
    age_boot_ci <- age_boot_ci[!is.na(age_boot_ci)]
    age_ci_lower[i] <- quantile(age_boot_ci, 0.025)
    age_ci_upper[i] <- quantile(age_boot_ci, 0.975)
#PI: parametric bootstrap with residual noise
    param_samples = mvrnorm(B, mu = params_est, Sigma = cov_mat)
    age_boot_pi = sapply(1:B, function(j) {
      a_j = param_samples[j, "a"]
      b_j = param_samples[j, "b"]
      r_j = param_samples[j, "r"]
# simulate new noisy observation
      y_j = rnorm(1, mean = pmax, sd = sigma_resid)
      invert_age(y_j, a_j, b_j, r_j)
    })
    age_boot_pi = age_boot_pi[!is.na(age_boot_pi)]
    age_pi_lower[i] = quantile(age_boot_pi, 0.025)
    age_pi_upper[i] = quantile(age_boot_pi, 0.975)
    age_pi_bootstrap[[i]] = age_boot_pi
  }
  
# Append results to data frame
  df$age_point = age_point
  df$age_CI_lower <- age_ci_lower
  df$age_CI_upper <- age_ci_upper
  df$age_PI_lower = age_pi_lower
  df$age_PI_upper = age_pi_upper
  df$age_PI_bootstrap = age_pi_bootstrap
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
test_genera_dated = predict_age_from_pmax(test_genera_w, "pydamage_pmax", fit_pmax, B = 2000)
head(test_genera_dated)
```

# 6. Fit logit model for probabilisitic age ranking based on p_max_differences
## 6.1 constructing paired datasets
#### Training data
```{r}
pairs_train = data_w[data_w$median_age_yrs_bf_1950<32000,] %>%
  dplyr::select(sample,median_age_yrs_bf_1950, pydamage_pmax) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_i")) %>%
  crossing(

    delta_pmax = pydamage_pmax_j - pydamage_pmax_i,
```

## 6.2 fitting logit model 
```{r}
pmax_logit = glm(
  y_ij ~ delta_pmax,
  family = binomial(),
  data = pairs_train
```

### 6.2.1 bootstrapping confidence band
```{r}
bootstrap_pairwise_by_genus_sample <- function(
  data,
  time_col = "median_age_yrs_bf_1950",
  damage_col = "pydamage_pmax",
  sample_col = "sample",
  genus_col = "genus",
  R = 100,
  seed = 1963) {
  set.seed(seed)
 #construct pairs from data
  all_pairs <- data %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_i")) %>%
    crossing(
      data %>% rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_j"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!!sym(paste0(sample_col, "_i")) != !!sym(paste0(sample_col, "_j"))) %>%
    mutate(delta_pmax = !!sym(paste0(damage_col, "_j")) - !!sym(paste0(damage_col, "_i")))
#define range of delta_pmax  
  delta_seq <- seq(
    min(all_pairs$delta_pmax),
    max(all_pairs$delta_pmax),
    length.out = 100)
  # Precompute unique levels and their row indices
  genus_levels = unique(data[[genus_col]])
  sample_levels = unique(data[[sample_col]])
  genus_index_list = lapply(genus_levels, function(g) which(data[[genus_col]]  == g))
  sample_index_list = lapply(sample_levels, function(s) which(data[[sample_col]] == s))
  # Container for predictions
  pred_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = R, ncol = length(delta_seq))
  for (r in seq_len(R)) {
    ## 1) Resample genus *clusters* by index, with replacement
    g_ids = sample(seq_along(genus_levels),
                    size = length(genus_levels),
                    replace = TRUE)
    ## 2) Resample sample *clusters* by index, with replacement
    s_ids = sample(seq_along(sample_levels),
                    size = length(sample_levels),
                    replace = TRUE)
    ## 3) Get the row indices for the resampled clusters
    rows_g = unlist(genus_index_list[g_ids])
    rows_s = unlist(sample_index_list[s_ids])
    ## 4) Intersection: rows that belong to both a resampled genus and sample
    rows_keep = intersect(rows_g, rows_s)
    d_resample = data[rows_keep, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(d_resample) < 2) {
      next  # skip iteration if not enough data
    }
    #build pairs and fit glm based on resampled data
    pairs = d_resample %>%
      rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_i")) %>%
      tidyr::crossing(
        d_resample %>% rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_j"))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data[[paste0(sample_col, "_i")]] != .data[[paste0(sample_col, "_j")]]) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        delta_pmax = .data[[paste0(damage_col, "_j")]] -.data[[paste0(damage_col, "_i")]],
        y_ij = as.integer(.data[[paste0(time_col, "_j")]] >.data[[paste0(time_col, "_i")]]))
    if (nrow(pairs) == 0) {
      next}
    mod = glm(y_ij ~ delta_pmax, family = binomial(), data = pairs)
    pred_matrix[r, ] = predict(mod,newdata = data.frame(delta_pmax = delta_seq),type = "response") }
# Compute 95% CI from pred_matrix
ci = apply(pred_matrix, 2, function(x) quantile(x, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE))
ci_df = data.frame(
  delta_pmax = delta_seq,
  lwr = ci[1, ],
  upr = ci[2, ],
  fit = apply(pred_matrix, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE))
# Return complete results
list(bootstrap_predictions = pred_matrix,ci_df = ci_df)}
```
```{r}
result_two_way = bootstrap_pairwise_by_genus_sample(data = data_w[data_w$median_age_yrs_bf_1950 < 32000, ],R = 500)
```

### 6.2.2 Plot
```{r}
plottable_logit=result_two_way$ci_df %>% mutate(orig_pred = predict(pmax_logit, 
                    newdata = data.frame(delta_pmax = .$delta_pmax), 
                    type = "response"))
```
```{r}
find_cutoff_crossing <- function(df, p) {
  df %>%
    filter(orig_pred >= p | lwr >= p | upr >= p) %>%
    summarise(
      prob = p,
      delta_pmax_fit = min(delta_pmax[orig_pred >= p], na.rm = TRUE),
      delta_pmax_lwr = min(delta_pmax[lwr >= p], na.rm = TRUE),
      delta_pmax_upr = min(delta_pmax[upr >= p], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

cut_095 <- find_cutoff_crossing(plottable_logit, 0.95)
cut_075 <- find_cutoff_crossing(plottable_logit, 0.75)

bind_rows(cut_095, cut_075)
```

```{r}
Scurve=ggplot(plottable_logit, aes(x = delta_pmax)) +

  labs(x = expression(p[max*','*j]*' - '*p[max*','*i] ), y = expression('P('*Age[j]*'>'*Age[i]*')')) +
```

### 6.3.1 ROC

```{r}
roc_obj <- roc(
  response = pairs_test$y_ij,
  predictor = pairs_test$pred_prob
)
```
```{r}
auc_value <- auc(roc_obj)
auc_value
```
```{r}
roc_df <- data.frame(
  specificity = roc_obj$specificities,
  sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities
) %>%
  mutate(
    fpr = 1 - specificity
  )

roc=
  ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = fpr, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "False Positive Rate",
    y = "True Positive Rate") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9)+
  annotate( "text",x = 0.6, y = 0.2,label = paste0("AUC = ", round(auc_value, 3)),size = 3)+
  coord_fixed()
roc
```

### 6.3.2 Classification threshold
```{r}
coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = c("threshold","sensitivity", "specificity"), best.method="youden")
```

```{r}
qlogis(c(0.5)) / coef(pmax_logit)['delta_pmax']
```
0.5 is the most suited threshold for class separation, this corresponds to a delta_pmax of 0 (as expected for logit model)

```{r}
pairs_test$pred_class <- pairs_test$pred_prob > 0.5
```

```{r}
table(
  truth = pairs_test$y_ij,
  pred  = pairs_test$pred_class
)

mean(pairs_test$y_ij == pairs_test$pred_class)
```

```{r}
mean((pairs_test$delta_pmax > 0) == pairs_test$y_ij)
```

### 6.3.3 Binned data approach

```{r}
pairs_test_plot <- pairs_test %>%
  mutate( correct = as.integer((delta_pmax > 0) == (median_age_yrs_bf_1950_j>median_age_yrs_bf_1950_i)), abs_dp = abs(delta_pmax),
      dp_bin = cut_width(abs_dp, width = 0.025, boundary = 0),include.lowest = TRUE)%>% 
 mutate(correct = factor(correct, levels = c(0, 1),
                     labels = c("Incorrect", "Correct"))) %>% 
  group_by(dp_bin, correct) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(dp_bin) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))
```
```{r}
bars=ggplot(pairs_test_plot, aes(x = dp_bin, y = prop, fill = correct)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9, alpha=0.5) +
  labs(
    x = expression("|"*Delta*"("*p[max]*")|"),
    y = "Probability of correct ranking",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Incorrect" = "darkred", "Correct" = "grey40")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),legend.position='none'
  )
bars
```
